title: Need help fixing a broken field mapping in Make?
text: I recently worked through a controlled Make automation demo where an inquiry was successfully received (HTTP 200), but the message field wasn’t making it into the spreadsheet. I traced the problem to a missing mapping, restored it, and verified the fix with a fresh submission. The next spreadsheet row came through correctly with all five expected fields. I’m offering a small, clearly scoped service for this exact kind of problem: one Make mapping repair , including before/after screenshots and a short written verification of the fix. If your Make scenario runs but a field is missing, blank, or going to the wrong place, send me a description of the problem and a screenshot. Please remove any passwords, API keys, customer data, or other private information first. I’ll tell you whether it’s something I can fix within the scope of the service.
triage_reason: Consultant offering a paid service to fix Make automation field mappings.

title: Looking for n8n / AI Automation Specialist – Paid QA & Stress Testing
text: Hi everyone, I’m looking for an experienced n8n specialist to review and stress-test several AI agents I’ve already built before I demonstrate them to paying clients. Stack includes n8n, Vapi, Twilio, ElevenLabs, OpenAI/Claude and APIs/webhooks . I’m looking for someone who can review existing workflows, identify bugs/failure points, test edge cases and error handling, check integrations and AI behaviour, and recommend/fix anything that isn’t client-ready. I’m not looking for the agents to be rebuilt from scratch. I’d like to start with one agent as a paid trial , with ongoing work available if we’re a good fit. If interested, please DM me with: Your location/time zone Your rate Relevant n8n/AI experience Any Vapi/Twilio/ElevenLabs experience Examples of similar work Thanks
